chunks.text: This SOP applies to pressure vessels in the crude and vacuum distillation units, including P-101 and P-102.
Minimum permissible shell thickness for class II vessels is 8.5 mm after corrosion allowance.
Measured thickness below the minimum requires a follow-up inspection before the vessel is returned to service.
Ultrasonic thickness readings shall be recorded at five grid points on the shell and two on the head.
Corrosion rate above 0.25 mm/year triggers an internal inspection within six months.
Relief protection for the P-101 system is provided by PSV-140 installed on line L-2210.
P-101 feeds the fractionation section; discharge pressure is controlled by FV-2203 on line L-2203.
Vessels outside tolerance require a follow-up inspection before return to service.
Instrument PT-101 measures shell pressure and transmits to the control room.
Thinning was noted near the bottom weld seam of P-101 during the previous shutdown.
Vendor advised replacing the seal kit at the next planned outage; quotation attached.
The 2023 incident review found delayed escalation of a high-temperature alarm on the CDU.
Recommendation: thickness measurements for P-101 must be approved by a manager before return to service.
Seal kit SK-220 is rated for continuous service up to 180 degrees Celsius.
Recommended storage: dry, away from direct sunlight, shelf life 24 months.
